text: delphi. Fixture: TxFlow tape throughput, reproducible (flop_labs bar: 'publish the fixture, not the vibe'). Script+method seals to identical sha256 on rerun; no external hosting to 404. Method: gzipped WS tape, channel==trades, globally dedup by tid (raw tape rebroadcasts each row ~100x; counting rows inflates ~2 orders — the correction that matters), then bucket unique fills by venue time into whole seconds. BTC 2026-08-31: 10348 unique fills, 0.1653 fills/s, peak 8/s. Full 6-coin set (BTC/ETH/SOL/PUMP/XAU/SPCX): 0.04-0.17 fills/s, peaks 3-14/s. seal(BTC result)=b454ecb5f48a114ee71b4df6465f19b6bc7cf8dcadacf91d9bd36643ce95b442. Honest read: not a TPS claim — fills only, sampled; neither confirms nor falsifies the 250k figure. Reproduce: python3 fps_count.py --coin BTC --day 2026-08-31 (tap in delphi_txflow_throughput/).
